name: Preparatory Physics Laboratory - II
description: The course consists of a total of eight experiments — two Foundational and six Core experiments — covering electrostatics, magnetostatics, optics, and modern physics. Foundational experiments build instrument-handling technique with a digital multimeter and observation of electrostatic phenomena using a Van de Graaff generator. Core experiments build on this through lab reports and viva, covering data collection, analysis and interpretation — examining Ohm's Law and Wheatstone bridge resistance networks, the Biot-Savart Law via magnetic field measurement, refractive index via a travelling microscope and minimum angle of deviation of prism, Planck's Constant via LED, and atomic spectra via diffraction grating.
